paths.role: Producer boundary for long-range Coulomb force, reciprocal energy, and direct virial outputs.
paths.why: TP1.8c already traced the PME-versus-Ewald split at this boundary.

paths.role: Caller-side handoff that passes ForceWithVirial and energy terms from long-range calculation into downstream post-processing.
paths.why: TP1.8d records after_longrange and after_accumulate_energy snapshots here.

paths.role: Immediate consumer that sums ForceWithVirial.force_ into the final force buffer and adds direct virial contributions to vir_force.
paths.why: TP1.8d records before_postprocess and after_postprocess snapshots around this consumer.

paths.role: Finalizes potential-energy bookkeeping from per-term energy contributions.
paths.why: TP1.8d records after_accumulate_energy snapshots to see whether the Coulomb reciprocal term survives into final potential bookkeeping.

paths.role: Storage and accumulation buffer for direct virial contributions consumed by postProcessForces.
paths.why: This is the object whose contents are transferred downstream into vir_force.
